body:
In every text box with a send or save button, Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on a Mac) presses that button, as the Strategy and Design message box already does (`plan_panel.send_key`).

This includes answering a question, adding a note, and editing a task, a feature or a milestone. A disabled button means the keys do nothing. A box with no send or save button is unchanged.

**Tests:** in each such box, Ctrl+Enter and Cmd+Enter send or save; Enter alone still adds a new line.
title: editors: Ctrl+Enter sends or saves
